[1/1] Plan: take over a home lock whose owner PID is dead, so a killed server no longer blocks the next start; keep the mtime rule for unreadable locks

impact_assessment.why: Stage 4 found a stale .lock naming a dead PID; the next start refused with already_running until the file was deleted by hand.
impact_assessment.benefits: Immediate restart after a crash or kill; no manual lock deletion.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: lock semantics; dependency: node process.kill signal 0; concurrency: a live owner replying; state: unlink race
impact_assessment.mitigation: only unlink when the file still names the judged-dead PID; treat EPERM and unreadable owners as live; add tests and a live kill/restart repro
